description_en: Deletes the snapshot configuration for live streams in an application. The deletion takes effect after you restart stream ingest
description_zh: 解除直播流下AppName的截图配置，重新推流后生效
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-live-app-snapshot-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLiveAppSnapshotConfig

parameters.description_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. The value of this parameter must be the same as the application name in the ingest URL. Otherwise, the configuration does not take effect. You can view the application name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.
parameters.description_zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. The value of this parameter must be the same as the application name in the ingest URL.
